eas_text: A civil authority has issued AN ADMINISTRATIVE MESSAGE for the following counties or areas: Arizona; at 3:11 PM on SEP 3, 2026 Effective until 11:11 PM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: This is the Department of Public Safety.  A SAFE Alert has been issued for Phoenix Police Department. The Phoenix Police Department is looking for 57 year old Carla Leguero.  Carla is a white female, 5 feet 6 inches tall, 210 pounds and has brown hair with hazel eyes. She was last seen at 6:00 AM on 9/3/26 on foot wearing a red shirt, blue shorts, and white / tan shoes near North 43rd Avenue and West Peoria Avenue in Phoenix, Arizona.  Carla has a medical condition which may cause her to become lost or easily confused.  If you have seen Carla, please contact the Phoenix Police Department at 602-534-2121 or call 911. If you have contact with this SAFE Alert, please call 911. Monitor TV and Radio for updates.
